title: Carboxymethyl-Sagocellulose-Stabilized Fe3O4 Nanoparticles
author: Anand Kumar Veeramachineni
materials: Stir for 12 hours in the dark.
Assess cell viability using MTT assay.

steps.title: Prepare iron precursor solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.08 g ferric chloride hexahydrate and 3.0 g sodium acetate in 40 mL ethylene glycol, homogenize the mixture, and transfer it to an autoclave.

steps.title: Conduct solvothermal synthesis
steps.instruction: Heat the autoclave at 200 °C for 10 hours, then allow the reaction mixture to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Collect and dry Fe3O4 particles
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitate with deionized water and dry it at 30 °C overnight.

steps.title: Disperse Fe3O4 nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Disperse 0.60 g Fe3O4 nanoparticles in 350 mL ethanol and 3 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Functionalize with APS
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL ammonium persulfate (APS) to the dispersion and stir for 12 hours under a nitrogen atmosphere at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and dry functionalized particles
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitate with deionized water and dry it at 30 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare CMSC solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g carboxymethyl‑sagocellulose (CMSC) in 200 mL PBS (pH 7.0).

steps.title: Activate CMSC with EDC/NHS
steps.instruction: Add EDC and sulfo‑NHS at a molar ratio of 0.5 relative to the carboxyl groups of CMSC, then dialyze against distilled water for 6 hours to remove unreacted reagents.

steps.title: Couple 5‑FU and Fe3O4‑NH2
steps.instruction: Mix the activated CMSC with 5‑fluorouracil (5‑FU) and Fe3O4‑NH2 nanoparticles, and stir for 12 hours.

steps.title: Recover final nanocomposite
steps.instruction: Use a magnet to collect the nanoparticles, wash them with deionized water, and dry the product.

steps.title: Incubate cells with nanocomposite
steps.instruction: Incubate HeLa cells with Fe3O4‑CMSC‑5‑FU nanoparticles at concentrations of 75, 150, and 300 µg/mL for 12 hours.

steps.title: Laser irradiation of cells
steps.instruction: Irradiate the cells with an 808 nm laser at a power density of 2 W/cm² for 1–3 minutes.
